activation_rules.meta_glasses_capture_enabled: Build includes real SDK AND platform/release-channel entitlement verified AND rollout eligible AND supported device/OS AND permission granted AND not killed
activation_rules.remote_glasses_capture_enabled: Glasses capture eligible AND active session explicitly armed locally AND same-account request AND fresh device state
activation_rules.meta_glasses_audio_enabled: Glasses capture eligible AND qualified audio capability AND explicit microphone permission and selected source
activation_rules.concentrate_analysis_enabled: Configured key AND qualified role profile AND verified privacy settings AND account/global budget AND provider readiness

note: False activation defaults prevent unqualified rollout, not omission from implementation. CI experimental artifacts must contain and exercise the real feature. Server evaluation is authoritative. Disabling capture never deletes existing media.
